_comment: Configuration for scripts/build_dataset.py. Mapping rules are read from config/roles.json (unchanged); only the overrides below are applied on top of them. Nothing here calls any API.

dedup.representative_for_same_id: records with full run provenance first, then earliest collected_at, then run name, file, page, position
dedup.representative_for_near_duplicate_group: most recent created, then smallest numeric job id
dedup.near_duplicate_confirmation: candidate groups from the 150-char key are merged only when the full normalized snippet is identical (templated postings with different requirements after char 150 are kept)

salary.assumption: Numeric plausibility screen only (100,000 to 10,000,000). The Adzuna response has no currency or period field; salary period/currency interpretation is UNRESOLVED and is not asserted as a source fact.

quality.future_tolerance_note: Adzuna 'created' values carry a 'Z' suffix but run up to ~4.9 h AHEAD of the collection clock (max created 22:51 vs collection ending 18:09 UTC on the same day), consistent with India local time (UTC+5:30) labelled as UTC. A record is 'future' only if created exceeds the latest collection time by more than 14 h (the largest UTC offset).

role_rule_overrides._decision: Project Manager handled as Option C: core Project Manager = canonical 'project manager' titles only; program / delivery / scrum-master titles become separate ADJACENT families. Evidence: previous 50-title manual audit found canonical titles 17 correct / 3 ambiguous / 1 incorrect, while 0 of 29 sampled program, delivery and scrum-master titles were correct (all ambiguous or incorrect, including every 'service delivery' title). No variant is validated, so Option B collapses into Option A. See report/dataset_documentation.md.
role_rule_overrides._graphic_designer_note: Motion-graphics designer titles are excluded from Graphic Designer (motion/video design is a different skill set). Evidence: 3 incorrect of 39 judged in the earlier 50-title audit and 3 incorrect of 15 judged in a fresh 20-title sample (pre-fix). This is the only recurring incorrect pattern for the role. Applied only in this build config; config/roles.json is unchanged.

employer_cap.applies_to: core roles, in the FINAL CORE ANALYSIS dataset only (the full validated dataset keeps every row and flags them)
employer_cap.cap_per_employer_within_role: max(1, floor(0.05 x role rows before cap))
employer_cap.tie_break: keep the most recent created, then the smallest numeric job id
employer_cap.missing_employer: never capped, never counted as an employer

salary.currency_interpretation: unresolved (country=in; not provided by the API)
